text: [photo: seedling trays on the potting bench, tomatoes and lettuce]
Tomatinhos e alface pegaram tudo
Que lindo!!
Nossa ficou ótimo who did the trays
Eu e o Matheus na quinta. He did the watering lol
I did not overwater them
You did a little
Will they be ready to go out by the mutirão?
Probably the lettuce yes. Tomatoes need another 2-3 weeks
Ok.
The corner by the fence gets sun till like 4 so put the tomatoes there when they're bigger 🍅
Agreed. The hose bib there is closest too
Carlos says the hose bib by the fence is leaking again. He's going to look at it tomorrow
It is the washer. I will bring one on Tuesday.
Ok tuesday works for me 👍
Night all. Don't kill my babies
Still up. The lettuce looks happy in the photo
Bom dia acabei de acordar, vou olhar os tomates antes do trabalho
Bom dia gente! Matheus tá vivo? 😂
Bom dia! Carlos já saiu pra comprar a arruela
Ele quer saber se a antiga era de 1/2 ou 3/4
1/2 eu acho. Se não lembrar manda foto da que tá vazando
Im up. Not dead. I think the washer is 1/2, I checked the bib thursday when I was watering
[photo: hose bib by the fence, dripping onto the gravel]
1/2. Confirmed. I will bring two in case.
Two lol ok 👍
Vou tá no laboratório até as 17h, depois passo no jardim se alguém ainda estiver lá
[photo: fence corner with afternoon sun on the bed]
Sun still hitting it at 4. Told you
Ok ok você ganhou kkk
Juliana, what time does the mutirão start Saturday? I'm on shift till 17
8. Juliana usually starts at 8.
Ok obrigada. Matheus are you coming Saturday or sleeping
Sat 8am is brutal but I'll come. Bringing my camera for the group photo
Carlos já dormiu, pediu pra avisar que traz as pás no sábado 👍
Going to sleep finally
Bought two. Both 1/2. Going to the garden after lunch.

[photo: seedling trays, one tomato leaning hard to the side]
Esse tomatinho tá torto. Alguém tem tutor?
Tem palito de churrasco no kit de ferramenta
Morning. Tutors are in the shed behind the compost bin, the green ones
Awake. Barely
Achei. Vou amarrar antes de ir pro lab
Carlos vai ao jardim depois do almoço com a arruela e a chave inglesa
Saio às 17 hoje. Dá pra passar lá se alguém ficar
Eu saio 17 também. Chego lá umas 17h40
Replaced the washer. Leak stopped. Tested.
[photo: hose bib by the fence, new washer, dry gravel underneath]
Ele ficou muito orgulhoso kkk
Obrigada Carlos!!
Cheguei. Juliana você tá aí?
Chegando. Tomate tá firme, o tutor funcionou

[photo: gravel under the bib, dry]
Tá seco. Carlos caprichou
Did anyone pick up the tutors or are they still in the shed
Ainda no jardim, deixei no vaso. Vou dormir 🌙
Going to bed soon. Night
